title: Jazeera Airways launches biggest-ever sale with Buy One, Get One Free offer on 3mln seats
summary: Across the entire Jazeera Airways network

contentHtml:
Jazeera Airways Airbus A320neo aircraft flying above clouds. Image Courtesy: Jazeera Airways

Across the entire Jazeera Airways network

Press Release

  • Special winter destinations such as Prague and Krakow, new destinations including Addis Ababa and Aswan
  • Travel period over six months

Kuwait: Jazeera Airways has launched its biggest-ever sale, giving travellers the chance to buy one ticket and get the second for free with 3 million seats available for travel across the airline’s entire network.

From 20 to 26 September 2026, passengers booking eligible flights can use promo code J9B1G1 to capture even more opportunities to travel with family and friends for less.

With 3 million seats included in the offer and a travel period running from 24 September 2026 to 27 March 2027, the promotion covers more than six months of travel.

The sale also comes as Jazeera Terminal 5 (T5) at Kuwait International Airport returns to 24-hour operations, providing passengers with greater flexibility and convenience as Jazeera Airways continues to expand its flight schedule and connectivity from Kuwait.

Whether it is a quick getaway within the GCC, a winter break in Prague or Krakow, exploring Africa through Addis Ababa, discovering Aswan and the Nile, or visiting family and friends across the Middle East and South Asia, Jazeera Airways’ biggest-ever sale puts twice the travel within easier reach.

Paul Carroll, Chief Commercial Officer, Jazeera Airways, said:

“This is our biggest-ever sale, with 3 million winter seats included in our Buy One, Get One Free offer across the entire Jazeera Airways network. With T5 now back to 24-hour operations and almost six months of travel included in the promotion, there has never been a better time for our passengers to plan their next journey. Whether it is a winter holiday, a family visit, a trip with friends or simply an opportunity to discover somewhere new, this offer makes it easier to travel together and experience more for less.”

Passengers can book through the Jazeera Airways website: jazeeraairways.com or mobile app using promo code J9B1G1 until 26 September 2026.
